name: Blackbird Farms
tagline: BLACKBIRD FARMS — west michigan growers group
description: Blackbird Farms is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in 5213 Roosevelt Street, MI. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
